purpose: Cross-identity Gemini lineage convergence for authenticated Gemini-labeled TITAN work that predates or sits outside the direct Antigravity author stream. This is part of the same single V4 convergence package and grants no runtime policy authority.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini endgame day-28/29 blanket work suppression
entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini endgame family recorded by current V4 GEMINI-CONVERGENCE; the literal calendar-only rule was intentionally not transplanted.
entries.literal_claim: Near terminal, suppress ordinary work based only on day 28/29 because there is too little time left for it to repay.
entries.best_form: Replace calendar-only suppression with source-bound terminal-horizon proofs. A work row may be removed only when its exact downstream production/service/liquidation chain cannot realize terminal cash before game end. Terminal labor, dead-action, capacity/custody and sale-timing owners remain authoritative.
entries.next_gate: Only a current-native exact-horizon theorem with returned-action witnesses and both-seat terminal economics may suppress work; no day-number-only rule.

entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini endgame family recorded by current V4 GEMINI-CONVERGENCE; blanket glut selling was intentionally not transplanted.
entries.literal_claim: When inventory is high near terminal, bleed glut with SELL rows without item/row-specific custody, quote, rival and funding analysis.
entries.best_form: Use only source-bound capacity/terminal sale descendants that prove the exact item, executable row, quote/crossflow, cargo custody, future funding and rival-benefit consequence. Generic 'glut => SELL' can worsen own receipt, rival receipt or next-callback funding.
entries.next_gate: Require an exact current-native item/row witness surviving downstream market transforms and positive both-seat terminal economics; never revive blanket glut bleed.

entries.literal_claim: Jointly optimize market-slot composition and timing around rival/public demand instead of treating each row independently.

entries.best_form: Recycle only a provably idle/dead row into a source-real service with exact actor inventory, target need, CARE/output value, EOD timing and cargo custody. The three historical arms remain separate economic hypotheses; preservation and focused tests are not field promotion.
entries.next_gate: Natural current-native engagement for each arm plus positive economics with zero starvation, CARE-value, timing or custody regression.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini G01 E11 rival-aware SELL deferral
entries.source_lineage: Gemini G01 commit 3379fd799766609691b4bb777e13f7b3cae0da00 / PR #11371 ancestry. Current V4 convergence records the broad historical rule as too coarse and competitively negative.
entries.literal_claim: Defer an existing SELL when rival dumping and a near-horizon price path make waiting better.
entries.best_form: Never defer from a coarse rival archetype or expected-drop guess. Stress the existing seller only with public one-way evidence, deterministic town drain, exact executable rows, custody, financing and bounded horizon. The stress surface emits no allow/deny decision bit.
entries.next_gate: Census current-native owner replay candidates and vetoes; only the existing seller/timing owner may consume a result after both-seat economics.

entries.source_lineage: Gemini G01 commit 3379fd799766609691b4bb777e13f7b3cae0da00 / PR #11371 ancestry; current V4 executable-prefix HIRE authority supersedes the crude guard.
entries.literal_claim: Drop a late low-value HIRE when there is not enough remaining work for the extra hand to repay its wage.
entries.best_form: Reason only over the official executable market prefix; inert suffix HIRE rows cannot consume allowance or create funding. Use exact Fibonacci wage/cash and current labor/service frontier rather than a crude unserved-tile count.
entries.next_gate: Current composed postimage plus current-native two-seat economics under exact executable-prefix and funding semantics.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini G01 O01 rival archetype model
entries.source_lineage: Gemini G01 commit 3379fd799766609691b4bb777e13f7b3cae0da00 / PR #11371 ancestry; static archetypes are retired in current V4.
entries.literal_claim: Classify the opponent by observed behavior and use that type to change market/capital choices.
entries.best_form: Replace identity/archetype labels with public one-way certificates only: already-realized net supply, visible standing production, same-row collision/crossflow and deterministic town demand. No rival private-shed inference or post-hoc acquisition prepend.
entries.next_gate: Public-evidence replay on current-native traces; acquisition or sale actions remain under current funding/execution owners.

entries.source_lineage: Gemini G01 commit 3379fd799766609691b4bb777e13f7b3cae0da00 / PR #11371 ancestry; fixed absorption weights are superseded by current source-bound demand models.
entries.literal_claim: Increase attractiveness of production/sales into products with strong shop absorption using a fixed multiplier.
entries.best_form: Replace fixed weights with exact integer shop/town transitions, unlock/replacement timing, shared RNG coupling and conservative absorption headroom. Demand evidence alone has no decision authority and excludes opponent supply unless separately proved.
entries.next_gate: A policy owner must combine current source-bound demand with real row, cash, capacity, custody and opponent-flow evidence before changing an action.

entries.source_lineage: Custom Gemini MERIDIAN Slack result (message p1788822548344359) proposed identical-prefix public-observation recourse; PR #10008 implemented the T15 adaptive authority and PR #10225 tightened exact continuation-prefix custody.
entries.literal_claim: Among plans sharing an identical committed prefix, choose a continuation after new public information partitions the still-compatible scenario streams.
entries.best_form: Preserve exact committed prefix and branch only on genuinely observable public information while retaining every world compatible with the full observation. The implementation has constructed-state positives but held A remained 20-20 vs 20-20 and held B 17-20 vs 17-20, so no runtime promotion follows from existence alone.
entries.next_gate: Show natural current-native recurrence, public observation separation, zero hidden-world leakage, and positive both-seat economics over the incumbent complete-plan decision.

entries.source_lineage: Custom Gemini MERIDIAN Slack result (message p1788816451643229) proposed public cash/mass-balance hidden-state feasibility; later T15 joint-capacity and interval-family work in PRs #10377/#10395 implemented stronger bounded descendants.
entries.literal_claim: Use public cash plus mass-balance constraints to exclude physically impossible rival market streams before robust maximin without inferring a single private inventory state.
entries.best_form: Use joint shared-shed capacity, keep carry separate, preserve uncertainty over unknown spending/purchases/deposits, respect ordered market semantics, and enumerate only complete same-lag feasible families with explicit fallback when the full family exceeds the bound. Never independently combine marginal per-product endpoints into an infeasible joint state.
entries.next_gate: Require a current-native robust decision that actually changes because a complete public-only feasible-family set removes a contradicted stream, then prove both-seat economics; current historical receipts tightened bounds but yielded zero newly ready families.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini S33 / STRATUM projected-shed SELL ordering
entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini STRATUM row-shed lane; current row-shed-sell-order package owns the single V4 implementation seam.
entries.literal_claim: Order already-authored SELL rows by projected shed relief so scarce end-of-day cargo/capacity is preserved.
entries.best_form: Projected-shed ordering is novel only if its effect survives the exact downstream canonical market-pressure transform into the action returned to the engine. A pre-pressure rank difference that later collapses to incumbent output is identity; internal diagnostics are not a witness.
entries.next_gate: Compare incumbent and STRATUM after the exact downstream pressure transform, bind any surviving difference to the returned action, then run current-native both-seat economics.
